prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / compositing.
Asset type: full-bleed printed metallic sealed trading-card booster wrapper.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: existing metallic Kanab Quest booster sachet, whose silhouette and three-dimensional foil material must be retained.
Image 2 is the supporting ILLUSTRATION REFERENCE: Sylvain crouching in the detailed CBD hemp field at sunset. Use this same illustration, same recognizable mascot, same pose, face, clothing, landscape and colors, but completely REMOVE its ornamental gold border, all four corner medallions, and any framing.
User correction: the ENTIRE metallic sachet is the printed illustration. The packaging is made from a sheet of foil that has the scene printed edge to edge, then folded and sealed. The image is NOT a label or a framed panel pasted onto green packaging.
Change required: spread the scene from Image 2 over EVERY visible square millimeter of the wrapper in Image 1: full width to the physical left and right edges, full height including the crimped top and bottom sealed strips, over the tucked side folds and corners. Top of wrapper shows the sky and tree canopy; the middle carries the field and Sylvain; the bottom shows foreground path and foliage. Sylvain remains large and easily recognized. No flat green margin anywhere, no silver unprinted band, no colored blank surround, no inset rectangle, no label, no outline border, no gold frame, no corner ornaments, no medallions.
Metallic realism: preserve the same soft foil bulges, crinkles, crease positions, reflective material and ribbed heat-sealed top and bottom ends as Image 1. Illustration INK conforms to those surfaces: natural fine wrinkles slightly distort its lines, broad soft silver-white specular reflections catch the colored printed surface, the sealed grooves show highlights and shadows through the print. The sky and foliage must continue across the end crimps; their metallic nature is conveyed by ribbing and sheen, not by blank silver stripes. It must still read clearly as a real sealed foil booster pack with a beautifully printed wrapper, not a flat card, not a paper poster.
Geometry: same 1024x1536 portrait canvas and front-facing camera, same pack scale and placement, same outer silhouette, approximate pack bounds x=134..890,y=114..1386. Preserve outside margins, do not enlarge the pack to the canvas edges. Keep BOTH crimped ends fully visible. No rotation or extra objects.
Background: true transparent RGBA outside the physical pack; clean alpha edge, no background scene, no floor, no glow, no shadow rectangle, no checkerboard painted into pixels. The scene exists ONLY as the print on the packaging.
Text: none. No words, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Produce a single finished isolated pack image.
encoding: Sharp WebP quality 94, alphaQuality 100, effort 6. No drawn or composited edits in code.
